widgets.name: summary
widgets.summary: A title, a lead paragraph, and the points that matter. The default way to replace a wall of text.

widgets.name: key-facts
widgets.summary: Labelled values in a two-column layout. For figures, config, and status at a glance.

widgets.name: findings
widgets.summary: A list of findings, each in its own callout, coloured by tone. For reviews, audits, and diagnostics.

widgets.name: comparison
widgets.summary: A table with a heading and an optional caption. For comparing options across the same dimensions.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows, each an array of cells matching columns

widgets.name: decision-matrix
widgets.summary: A comparison table plus a stated recommendation. Use when the point is the conclusion, not the data.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column headers, first one naming the option

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows, each an array of cells matching columns

props.name: recommendation
props.description: What the agent recommends and why

widgets.name: timeline
widgets.summary: Ordered events with a time and a description. For incident write-ups and change histories.

widgets.name: annotated-code
widgets.summary: Code blocks each preceded by the note explaining them. For diffs, snippets, and walkthroughs.

widgets.name: ask
widgets.summary: One question, with optional context above it. The smallest collecting brief.

widgets.name: survey
widgets.summary: Several questions under one heading. Field specs are passed through as given.

widgets.name: approval
widgets.summary: A summary of what is proposed, a three-way decision, and room for reasoning.

widgets.name: pick-one
widgets.summary: A choice between options, with room to say why. For 'which of these should I do'.

props.name: question
props.description: The question shown above the options

widgets.name: rate-items
widgets.summary: The same rating scale applied to several items. For prioritisation and confidence checks.

fields.idRule: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only, starting with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters — so `max-await-ms`, never `max_await_ms`
fields.common: kind, id, label, required — and help? for a line of guidance under the label

kinds.summary: Free text. There is no separate textarea kind; a multi-line box is `long: true`.
kinds.attributes: long?: boolean for a multi-line box, maxLength?: number

kinds.summary: Yes or no, rendered as a pair of radios.
One of a fixed set, or several when multiple is true.
A whole number on a scale starting at 1.
